title: Permutation in String
summary: Given two strings s1 and s2, determine if s2 includes any permutation of s1 as a substring, returning true or false accordingly.
statement: Given two strings s1 and s2, determine if s2 includes any permutation of s1 as a substring, returning true or false accordingly.
constraints: Return true exactly when some contiguous substring of s2 is a permutation of s1.
reference_solution:
def contains_permutation(s1,s2):
    if len(s1)>len(s2):return False
    from collections import Counter
    need=Counter(s1);window=Counter(s2[:len(s1)])
    if window==need:return True
    for right in range(len(s1),len(s2)):
        window[s2[right]]+=1;left=s2[right-len(s1)];window[left]-=1
        if window[left]==0:del window[left]
        if window==need:return True
    return False

    need=Counter(s1);window=Counter(s2[:len(s1)])
    if set(window)==set(need):return True

Initialize first window; slide one character out and one in; compare counts.
Every candidate substring has exactly the pattern length, so matching frequency maps is necessary and sufficient.
